title: A HIRE ON AN ORDER MOVES ONCE
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08 (the second half of H13, left open then). Any loud noise, a Crier alarm or the siege pull sent your hire toward the noise, and then his FOLLOW or HOLD order moved him again in the same frame, so he moved at about twice his speed and jittered between the two. A hire under FOLLOW or HOLD now lets the noise go and is moved by his order alone. A hire with no order still investigates.
now: Your hire on FOLLOW or HOLD no longer jitters and doubles his speed when he hears a noise.
